title: Sources: the UK's proposed under-16 social media ban is expanding to target recommender systems and user content, including YouTube Kids, Lego Play, and Spotify (Jessica Elgot/The Guardian)
summary: Jessica Elgot / The Guardian: Sources: the UK's proposed under-16 social media ban is expanding to target recommender systems and user content, including YouTube Kids, Lego Play, and Spotify — Regulations under consideration could affect up to 150 platforms, including LegoPlay, Spotify and eBay, sources say
